mapper.select: SELECT feedback_id, user_id, order_id, order_item_id, recommended_size, purchased_size, satisfaction, issue_parts, note, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM size_feedback WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO size_feedback ( user_id, order_id, order_item_id, recommended_size, purchased_size, satisfaction, issue_parts, note, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{orderId}, #{orderItemId}, #{recommendedSize}, #{purchasedSize}, #{satisfaction}, #{issueParts}, #{note}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE size_feedback SET recommended_size = #{recommendedSize}, purchased_size = #{purchasedSize}, satisfaction = #{satisfaction}, issue_parts = #{issueParts}, note = #{note}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE feedback_id = #{feedbackId}
mapper.select: SELECT sf.user_id, sf.order_id, sf.order_item_id, sf.satisfaction, COALESCE(sf.update_time, sf.create_time) AS feedback_time, rl.school_id, rl.uniform_id, rl.recommended_size_id FROM size_feedback sf INNER JOIN s_orders so ON so.id = sf.order_id LEFT JOIN recommendation_log rl ON rl.order_item_id = sf.order_item_id WHERE COALESCE(sf.update_time, sf.create_time) >= #{startTime} AND COALESCE(sf.update_time, sf.create_time) <= #{endTime} AND so.status = 3 AND COALESCE(so.payment_status, '') NOT IN ('REFUNDING', 'REFUNDED', 'CLOSED') AND COALESCE(so.shipping_status, '') NOT IN ('RETURN_REQUESTED', 'RETURNED')
